description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named 'LayoutAnimation5'. It loads installed launcher applications and displays their icons in a grid view with layout animation. The activity includes a custom adapter 'AppsAdapter' to manage and display application icons.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation5
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays launcher applications in a grid with layout animation.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter, which provides icon views for the apps to be displayed in the GridView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads app data, sets the layout, and attaches the adapter to the GridView.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the package manager for launcher activities and stores the list in mApps.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns an ImageView for each app icon to display in the grid.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display, limiting to a maximum of 32.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the ResolveInfo object for the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the ID for the item.
